definitions.gloss: to practice; to train; to rehearse
definitions.explanation: To repeat an activity or skill in order to improve at it. Used for practicing musical instruments, sports, languages, and other skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練習|れんしゅう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I practice the piano every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{練習|れんしゅう}した。
examples.english: The whole team practiced in preparation for the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{練習|れんしゅう}した⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いった。
examples.english: Thanks to practicing the speech many times before the presentation, the real thing went well.

notes:
One of the most frequently used words for practice and training. Covers a wide range of activities from casual hobbies to serious athletic or artistic training.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧: practice match; scrimmage
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}{問題|もんだい}→練習問題：21219_renshuumondai⟧: practice problems; exercises
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: practice time
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧: training regimen
- ⟦{自主|じしゅ}→自主：13979_jishu⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: self-directed practice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to train — more intensive and systematic; used for military, emergency, or professional training
- ⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to practice — used specifically for traditional arts (martial arts, tea ceremony, dance)
- ⟦{特訓|とっくん}→特訓：13466_tokkun⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do intensive training — implies concentrated, rigorous practice over a short period

USAGE:
The noun ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧ is very commonly used on its own, often as a compound element. In casual speech, it is sometimes shortened to {練|れん} (e.g., {朝練|あされん} for morning practice).
